Implemented and pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1018 (commit 571f6d2ab, branch 7ab3-structural-link-comparability).

What landed in the change:
- resolve_hierarchy_link now resolves blocking pairs via the nearest common ancestor of the two endpoints. _get_ancestors terminates every chain with a _VIRTUAL_ROOT sentinel, so parentless tickets are siblings and there is no undefined disjoint-tree case; a new _resolve_blocking_endpoints helper does the NCA lookup and returns (resolved_source, resolved_target, is_ancestor_pair).
- _get_ancestors lost its max_hops=2 cap and gained a visited-set cycle guard.
- _TYPE_TIER, _tier_of, _tier_of_ticket and _promote_to_tier deleted; grep over src/ and tests/ confirms zero remaining references.
- is_redundant is recomputed from the RESOLVED pair inside the blocking branch only. The non-blocking early return keeps the original-pair value untouched, so relates_to / duplicates / supersedes / discovered_from / caused_by gain no new rejections.
- Rejection wording widened in _links.py and in composer._link_dry_run; no new branch was needed in either, since both already handle is_redundant.
- Six prose sites updated (link.txt, ticket-model.md, event-schema.md, cli-reference.md, user-guide.md, plus the ticket-model section heading).

Two findings from implementation that the plan did not anticipate:

1. A self-loop (source == target) was being swallowed by the ancestor check and raised ValueError("redundant link") instead of CyclicDependencyError, breaking test_add_dependency_raises_on_self_loop_at_level. A ticket is not its own ancestor, so _resolve_blocking_endpoints now returns identical endpoints untouched and lets the existing cycle guard handle them. This was NOT in the plan and was caught only by the existing suite.

2. The predicted three-test inversion held exactly. SC3, SC5 and the parametrised cousins case changed and produced precisely the predicted endpoints; the other eight resolver tests passed unmodified, including both halves of the former type-tier fallback test (renamed, assertions untouched) and test_resolve_hierarchy_link_is_redundant_direct_parent.

Verification: pytest tests/scripts/graph/ = 74 passed. Full tests/unit + tests/scripts + tests/interfaces = 7479 passed, 32 skipped; the 2 reported errors were a REPO_ROOT-leak guard tripping on a .mypy_cache created by a concurrent make typecheck in the same worktree, and both files pass clean when re-run alone. make lint and make typecheck both pass. _hierarchy.py is 282 lines, well under the 800 cap.

Not yet done: awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submit; ticket stays in_progress until the change merges and the worktree is fast-forwarded.
